title: 2027/28: last day for visa applications 31.10.2027
text: Official MUR circular: for 2027/28 the bachelor's and master's visa deadline is 31 October (in 2026/27 it was 30 November). A university may set an earlier deadline.

title: Unical: 132 full scholarships for foreign master's students (2026/27)
text: Tuition fees, free dormitory and meals, plus a 3 600 € allowance. The 2027/28 call is expected in January 2027.

title: From 2026/27 the proof of funds for the visa has increased: 10 179,85 €
text: The annual funds requirement for the student visa rose from 6 947,33 € to 10 179,85 €. Prepare your bank statement accordingly.

title: Politecnico di Milano: master's applications open
text: Early bird until 01.12.2026 (also for scholarship candidates), general call until 28.01.2027.

title: Pavia: 2nd call 12–20 January 2027
text: Application fee 35 €. The 1st call closed on 18.11.2026.

title: Torino and Bicocca applications open
text: Torino master's: 25.11.2026 – 29.01.2027 (70 €). Bicocca open-admission programmes: until 22.12.2026.

title: 2026/27 scholarship minimum: 7 171,11 €
text: The minimum amount set by the state for a student living away from their family. ISEE limit 28 339,88 €.
